name: dxplay-tv-web
description: DX Play for Samsung (Tizen), VIDAA and LG (webOS) TVs - web TV app. index.html = app, w0.html = W0 proof.

scripts.tizen: npm run build && node packaging/assemble.mjs tizen
scripts.vidaa: npm run build && node -e "require('fs').existsSync('w0.local.json')&&require('fs').copyFileSync('w0.local.json','dist/w0.local.json')" && vite preview --host --port 4173
scripts.webos: npm run build && node packaging/assemble.mjs webos
